text: むずかしそうな　もじや　すうじ　ばかりで　ちんぷんかんぷん！？

structure.jp: むずかしそうな　もじや　すうじ　ばかりで
structure.en: it's nothing but difficult-looking letters and numbers, so

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks)
patterns.explanation: そう put on a describing word with its last い dropped says how something looks to you. むずかしそうな　もじ = 'difficult-looking letters'.

patterns.name: 〜ばかり
patterns.explanation: ばかり after a thing says there is nothing else but that. もじや　すうじ　ばかり = 'nothing but letters and numbers'.

patterns.name: 〜で (reason)
patterns.explanation: で here gives the reason for what follows, like 'and so'. すうじ　ばかりで = 'it's all numbers, so...'.
